Method of Attack: Versioning: releasing an initial benign app version on Google Play Store that passes checks, then updating it from a third-party server to enable malicious activity
Dynamic Code Loading (DCL): loading malicious code from servers controlled by threat actors to evade static analysis
Trojanized app downloads full malware version after initial limited functionality app installation
Camouflaged as Android antivirus software and system utilities to evade detection
Attack Vector: Google Play Store initial app submission with benign version
Third-party server updates delivering malicious payload
Dynamic code loading from external servers
Indicators of Compromise: Apps that passed Google Play Store submission checks but later download malicious code
Trojanized apps disguised as antivirus or system utilities
